doi.title: Repository identifier
doi.description: Persistent identifier (DOI) for the repository records in NKR.

repositoryName.title: Repository name
repositoryName.description: Official repository name (usually in the original language).

additionalNames.title: Alternative repository names
additionalNames.description: Alternative repository name or acronym of the official repository name.

type.title: Repository type
type.description: Repository type according to its content and purpose.

status.title: Repository status
status.description: Actual repository development or production status.

software.title: Software
software.description: Software used in the repository. Select from the list or enter your own text.

releaseDate.title: Repository release date
releaseDate.description: The date when the repository moves or will move into the production phase. This can also be a planned date in the future.

endProduction.title: End of production phase
endProduction.description: The date when the repository has passed or will pass into the decommissioned phase. This may also be a planned date in the future.

subject.title: Subject classification
subject.description: Field(s) to which the repository content is dedicated, as defined by the Frascati Manual. Copy the URI's from https://vocabs.ccmm.cz/registry/codelist/SubjectCategory/. If the repository is generic, covering all subjects, it is necessary to select all 6 top level areas one by one.

keywordCz.title: Keywords in Czech
keywordCz.description: Freely formed keyword in Czech that describes the content and focus of the repository. Insert at least three.

keywordEn.title: Keywords in English
keywordEn.description: Freely formed keyword in English that describes the content and focus of the repository. Insert at least three.

mainContact.title: Main contact
mainContact.description: Contact for the end-user, e.g. a generic email.

organization.title: Organizations
organization.description: Organization(s) responsible for the repository management or specific part of the repository management (could be large research infrastructure or consortium). Provide a link to an object of type Organization.

mainUrl.title: Main repository URL
mainUrl.description: URL of the repository home page. Please fill in once the repository is public.

metadataSchema.title: Metadata schemas
metadataSchema.description: Metadata schemas used in the repository. Provide a link to an object of type MetadataSchema.

metadataSchemaUsage.title: Usage
metadataSchemaUsage.description: Usage of the metadata schema in the repository.

workingGroup.title: Relevant EOSC CZ working groups
workingGroup.description: EOSC CZ working groups relevant for the repository.

enum: DM-AI-ML - Data Management for AI and ML
items.title: Working Group

fundingProject.title: Funding projects
fundingProject.description: Funding grants or projects. Provide a link to an object of type Project.

remarks.description: Any remarks which are not possible to enter in another field.
remarks.title: Remarks

detailedInformation.title: Detailed information for the repository. Provide a link to an object of type RepositoryPlus.
